body: I wasn't sure if I should always restart timer. It's how it works in VS Code, but the search does not start until you stop writing. With the current condition, the inspector may update while you are typing, but it's still better than before.

It's safe to call `start()` directly. It starts the stopped timer or resets its time remaining.

This is also how AssetLib does de-bouncing:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/0eadbdb5d0709e4e557e52377fa075d3e2f0ad1f/editor/plugins/asset_library_editor_plugin.cpp#L1104-L1106
I don't get why this method takes Node, but I kept support for the old behavior just in case.
